scenarios.goal: Make the checkout test suite reliable in CI.
scenarios.workspaceDigest: shop-api (Bun, Hono, SQLite). tests/ 18 files; tests/checkout.test.ts is flaky in CI (1 in 5 runs). src/services/checkout.ts uses Date.now() and a payment client mock.
lessons: Inject a clock instead of calling Date.now() in services under test.

task.title: Fix the flaky checkout test
task.spec: tests/checkout.test.ts fails about one run in five in CI with a totals mismatch. Reproduce it, find the cause, fix the test or the code, and prove it with repeated runs.
acceptance: bun test tests/checkout passes 20 runs in a row

args.command: for i in $(seq 1 10); do bun test tests/checkout.test.ts || break; done

steps.say: Running only the failing case with a fixed seed.

args.command: bun test tests/checkout.test.ts -t 'applies tax at midnight' --rerun-each 20

steps.say: The tax rate switches at midnight; injecting a clock.

args.command: bun test tests/checkout.test.ts -t 'applies tax at midnight' --rerun-each 20

steps.say: The test still builds the service without a clock.

args.title: Checkout tax depends on wall clock
args.detail: checkout.ts read Date.now(), so runs near midnight UTC used the next day's tax table. Fixed by injecting a clock.

steps.say: Checking other services for the same pattern.

args.text: Services that depend on the time of day must take a clock dependency so tests can pin it.

args.summary: Root cause: wall clock in checkout tax. Injected a clock and pinned it in tests; 20 runs green.
